purpose: Explain the relationship between outdoor temperature and driving consumption for the selected vehicle, with seasonal context, deterministic diagnosis, recent drives and optional AI narration.
primaryGoal: Compare populated temperature ranges and drive consumption without confusing missing measurements, independent source periods or retained data with current evidence.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-keyed query, enabled only with a selected vehicle; forwards AbortSignal. Response types include points, efficiency, vampire_drain and monthly_trend. Page uses points and monthly_trend; recomputes populated buckets from points. No start/end parameters.
dataSources.units: Inspected frontend contract declares outside_temp/avg_temp Celsius, efficiency_wh_km Wh/km, distance_km kilometres. Actual backend serialization, SQL and source-window semantics were not inspected; do not infer canonical metres/Wh-per-metre merely from comments.

dataSources.behavior: Independent vehicle-keyed query with AbortSignal; latest/prior month explanation, verdict, percentages and Celsius difference. No shared range parameters; page explicitly describes its independent period.

dataSources.owner: AI feature gate, shared stream hook and cabin-temperature-impact-narrative handler
dataSources.behavior: User-triggered narration only; positive vehicle_id required; vehicle scopeKey changes abort/clear prior narration by the documented hook contract. Feature gate removes the surface when disabled. No POST was exercised.

dataSources.endpoint: useVehicles dependency; its request implementation was not inspected
dataSources.owner: workspace vehicle hook and persisted selectedVehicle store
dataSources.behavior: URL, persisted store and first-known-vehicle precedence. Page consumes this owner and does not introduce a local selector.

dataSources.endpoint: Existing preferences/formatting dependencies, not independently traced
dataSources.owner: shared display-boundary formatting and stat pipeline
dataSources.behavior: Temperature and distance preferences affect display; raw query payload is retained. Brief efficiency rawValue uses Wh/m derived by dividing source Wh/km by 1000; custom formatter restores original captions.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local KM_PER_MILE conversion and comments saying no efficiency helper exists compete with the existing convertEfficiencyFromSI helper.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse convertEfficiencyFromSI at the display boundary, retaining current source Wh/km and exact preference-dependent output; update obsolete comments without changing cache/wire units.
duplicatedPatterns.evidence: Local factor at line 67; shared helper web\src\lib\unitConversion.ts:257.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: sectionFallback already consolidates six panel states; do not create six bespoke competing fallback components during modernization.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain the existing local helper or compose the accepted SourceContent contract only after matching loading/error/empty/retained behavior.

issues.detail: Recent drives excludes distance_km from mobileColumns. DataTable documents that omitted keys become hidden below md; no mobilePresentation or renderExpanded is supplied by this page. This is a source-confirmed mobile detail-access gap, not measured clipping.
issues.fix: Keep distance reachable via existing DataTable mobile presentation/detail API or preserve all four columns with intentional horizontal access; do not drop it as mobile simplification.

issues.detail: Full recommendation sentences render inside small Badge components. Long translated text and 200% text may strain the single-column region; actual wrapping/overflow has not been exercised.
issues.fix: Prefer Text for explanatory prose with a short semantic badge/icon, retaining all recommendation content and localization. Validate 320px, long labels and 200% text.

accessibility.status: source evidence only; keyboard, screen reader, effective contrast and forced colors unverified
sourcePositives: Localized region labels at page:384,497,599 and localized chart ariaLabel props at 399,509,557.
Decorative legend dots and recommendation icons use aria-hidden; page imports shared table and typography primitives.
FadeIn.tsx:24-34 consumes existing motion preferences rather than an independent animation policy.

issues.detail: All three charts opt out of accessible data tables using chart-a11y:no-table comments (394,504,551) and supply no data/dataColumns fallback. The recent-drive table covers raw scatter inputs but not aggregate bucket or dual-axis monthly rows. Aggregate and dual-axis data can be represented as rows; a chart name alone does not convey their measurements.
issues.fix: Use the existing ChartContainer data/dataColumns accessibility contract for populated bucket averages and monthly drive count/temperature, preserving numeric units and missing values; retain recent drive table as the scatter detail alternative.
issues.evidence: web\src\components\charts\ChartContainer.tsx:152-175 describes the semantic name and fallback table contract.

states.loading: Initial query loading without retained data shows contextual panel skeletons via page:309; summary receives loading. Query disabled with no selected vehicle produces manage-vehicles guidance rather than a fabricated measurement.
states.empty: Each page card independently falls back to localized EmptyState; monthly and point arrays are independent. Source.hasData can be true for an empty response object, so summary may say Source data available while charts are empty.
states.error: Fatal error only replaces source-backed card content; each QueryError invokes refetch. Detective uses independent SourceContent recovery.
states.retained: Page explicitly uses fatalError rather than all query errors; retained chart/table data survives failed refresh. Brief adapter recognizes refreshError/isRefreshBlocked/stale.
states.offline: deriveDataState records paused refresh and retains payload; browser/offline recovery and page header trust rendering were not exercised or fully traced.
states.partial: Point and monthly panels can render independently, but the page does not explicitly mark missing monthly/point slices as partial/unavailable in deriveDataState options.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045 unknown is not zero
issues.detail: Missing efficiency and temperature become zero in averages/buckets/scatter (164,168,170,191-193), monthly missing temperature/count become zero (205-206), table missing efficiency/distance become zero (240,251). Although interfaces declare numeric fields, the explicit null fallbacks manufacture measured values if source fields are missing.
issues.fix: Validate finite source measurements, retain unknown markers, and exclude unavailable pairs from derived numeric calculations without discarding their source rows. Preserve true zero, source ownership, counts and diagnostics.

issues.detail: Empty temperature buckets receive avg=0 and remain in stats.bucketAvgs used by the line chart at 515, implying perfect measured efficiency and drawing connections through unobserved buckets. Best/worst correctly filters count>0; chart does not.
issues.fix: Keep bucket identity/count but represent empty averages as unavailable gaps, not zero. Preserve populated bucket calculations and all five range labels.

issues.detail: deriveDataState receives only provenance, so a successful empty response or one missing a subseries is not explicitly annotated unavailable/partial. MapsOperationalBrief checks hasData but not unavailable/partial statuses and may label these payloads available.
issues.fix: Derive source-specific empty/partial evidence using real response semantics, and extend the existing brief adapter's status mapping rather than replacing retained data. Do not treat an empty object as proof of a measured zero.

visualIssues.detail: Five fixed saturated hex bucket colors bypass current chart palette/theme preferences and create a rainbow scatter plus manual dot legend. Semantic cold-to-hot distinctions are meaningful; the implementation should not erase them, but fixed saturation is not necessary.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware restrained chart/category token semantics, preserving deterministic cold-to-hot bucket identity and matching legend labels. Do not force-reset saved palette choices or add a new per-page palette.

visualIssues.detail: Every efficiency table value is fixed text-cyan-300 regardless of theme or semantic exception, giving ordinary numeric body cells unnecessary accent emphasis.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing typography semantic primary/secondary tokens for ordinary values; retain meaningful best/worst badge signals and tabular number formatting.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative lightbulb is fixed text-cyan-300 rather than a semantic muted icon token; no corresponding status requires that accent.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing muted icon/text tokens; preserve verdict badge semantics and icon aria-hidden.

visualIssues.detail: Chart axis tick font sizes are hard-coded 10/11 and legend 12 at multiple sites rather than inherited shared chart typography. This is a source consistency issue, not measured illegibility.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current chart typography tokens/preferences while preserving axis data keys, labels, dual scales and subtle grid/reference hierarchy.

architectureIssues.detail: tips uses TrendingUp as a value but the import list at lines 3-6 omits it and this file declares no such binding. Populated best-range data reaches this reference. Source indicates an unresolved identifier and likely runtime failure; compiler/runtime confirmation is not claimed.
architectureIssues.fix: Import the existing icon from the current icon library/approved registry, retaining optimal/cold/hot recommendation behavior. Validate the populated-data path in the authorized implementation phase.

architectureIssues.detail: Dated analytics and recent-drive table do not consume useRangeState; /temperature-impact is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS, and the hook accepts only vehicleId. The brief honestly calls the source window unspecified. This is an integration gap, not proof that backend supports arbitrary bounds.
architectureIssues.fix: If this dated route adopts workspace range, coordinate backend/query support for both bounds and full-result aggregates, then register the real route and consume the shared header owner. Keep independently defined detective/latest-prior month semantics explicit; never add a second local date picker or client-only page filter.

architectureIssues.detail: Drive table keys are source array indices, not persistent drive identities. After refetch/reordering the same index may refer to a different drive; the inspected point interface has no drive ID.
architectureIssues.fix: Do not invent a backend drive identity. Preserve source order and tableId; coordinate a real stable identity if persisted row interaction requires it, or document/validate nonidentity row-key behavior.

order: Resolve missing TrendingUp binding without deleting recommendations.
Preserve unknown-versus-zero semantics and remove unobserved bucket zero points.
Preserve mobile distance access and supply aggregate chart text/data alternatives.
Coordinate source trust and workspace range support, without guessing backend behavior.
Adopt restrained palette/semantic text and existing efficiency conversion helper.

Register /temperature-impact only once server list and aggregate filtering supports both bounds.
requiredSharedChanges.note: No new range component or query-state owner; detective business months remain independent.

competingImplementations.detail: Local efficiency conversion duplicates existing convertEfficiencyFromSI at unitConversion.ts:257.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse the existing helper without changing source units.

competingImplementations.detail: Fixed bucket hex palette and hand-rendered dot legend coexist with current shared chart palette/legend pipeline. Category semantics are necessary; a second theme engine is not.
competingImplementations.fix: Use existing palette and label contracts while retaining range category identity, all points and current legend meaning.
